audit_definition.metric: minimum bidirectional max(p90 surface NN) across signed PCA-axis permutations
audit_definition.manual_screen: non-grocery miniature furniture, distinctive animal figures and footwear, excluding duplicate shark family within training

scene_layout: one target and two disjoint distractor meshes, composited by a z-buffer; texture, rotation, range, lighting, background, small depth noise and missing depth randomized with each fixed seed

system.network: 3-layer shared RGB-D pair CNN, 96-wide 4-head self attention across hypotheses, residual norm and one-logit MLP
system.training_input: two RGB / hypothesis-relative metric depth / valid-depth crops per hypothesis

loss.A: pose-conditioned triplet hinge, FoundationPose Eqs. 11–14, near-target perturbations
loss.B: pointwise BCE on A samples, correct defined by MSSD <0.1D
loss.C: A ranking objective with additional background and other-object hypotheses; off-target hypotheses are negative by construction

R4: Pooled strict cross-call pair accuracy image-bootstrap upper bound < 0.50 and pooled strict within-call accuracy >= 0.95
R5: B and C cross-call lower bound >= 0.80 and within-call accuracy >= A minus 0.03
R6: C-A cross-call accuracy gains on background and other-object errors each exceed gain on target-overlap errors
